results.persona: Pedro: plays keyboard-only (finds the mouse hard), has deuteranopia (emulated with CDP setEmulatedVisionDeficiency), and uses 125 % browser zoom on a 1280×800 screen (viewport 1024×560, DSF 2.5, prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)
results.summary:
Joguei cerca de 59 minutos reais só com teclado: nova campanha em Recruta, base colocada na Alemanha com as setas e o Espaço, investigação, contratações, construção de Alojamentos com o cursor da grelha, Equipar, gravação, duas missões de OVNI aterrado ganhas por teclado (incluindo abrir a porta do OVNI com ⌥+Enter, granada G com aviso de aliados no raio e kit médico), interceção com teclas 1–5/Q/E, relatório mensal de janeiro e Ufopédia. Quase todos os problemas das rondas 1 e 2 estão corrigidos:
- O cursor de teclado no combate funciona.
- As formas do caminho (●/○/✕) e o triângulo por cima dos alienígenas dispensam a cor.
- O foco fica preso nos diálogos.
- Os separadores da base mudam com ←/→.
- As linhas dos Soldados escolhem-se com ↑/↓.
- O relatório de missão desloca-se pelo teclado.
- A Ufopédia já não muda de artigo com o texto em foco.
- A paleta para daltónicos e a lista de teclas abrem bem.
O que ainda me trava:
- «Abortar missão» não tem tecla, o Tab não lá chega e não aparece nas Opções do combate.
- Com dois avisos, a 1024×560, as listas de OVNIs, locais e naves do Geoscape ficam abaixo do ecrã e o foco vai para lá sem se ver.
- O pânico dos soldados não aparece no resumo do turno: só se vê por uma risca roxa (azul para mim), e o Tab salta esses soldados sem explicação.
- No kit médico, o Tab não faz nada, as setas estão trocadas em relação ao desenho e não se vê que parte do corpo está escolhida.
- O relatório mensal esconde a parte de baixo (Nigéria −$43 000, total, contas do mês) e não se desloca por teclado.
Vale a pena continuar: é de longe a versão de X-COM mais jogável por teclado que já experimentei.

findings.claim: At 1024×560 (125 % on 1280×800), the Geoscape side panel overflows as soon as there are two persistent warnings («30 cientistas parados» and «Só N soldados aptos»). The «OVNIS DETETADOS», «LOCAIS» and «NAVES NO AR» lists go below the window, and the panel does not scroll. Tab puts focus on the UFO row outside the screen, so the keyboard user loses the focus and the list of contacts.
findings.evidence: 10 Jan 1999, OVNI-4 landed. .geo-side measures top 10 / bottom 550 with scrollHeight 631 > clientHeight 537 and overflow-y: visible. The «OVNIS DETETADOS» label is at y=585, and .geo-lists is at top 583 / bottom 643, with the window at 560. After Tab, activeElement is BUTTON «OVNI-4 · Aterrado · Batedor Grande» with rect y 603–642, and scrollTop is 0 on both the document and the aside. The «CONTRATAR SOLDADOS» button is cut off at the bottom edge (540–568). Screenshots: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/persona/r3/acessivel/shots/108-geo-side.png, 109-geo-lists-focus.png and 106-contratar-focus.png
findings.fix: Make .geo-side a flex column with max-height:100% and overflow:auto (or give .geo-lists flex:1 1 auto; min-height:0), and turn the warnings into compact single-line chips when height is under 640 px. On focusin inside the aside, call el.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'}). Add an «N avisos» summary that expands on demand.

findings.claim: «Abortar missão» cannot be reached from the keyboard. There is no shortcut, Tab in combat only cycles soldiers, and the Opções opened with Esc in combat offer only «SAIR PARA O MENU» and «FECHAR». A keyboard player cannot pull the team out of a lost mission.
findings.evidence: Mission 2, turn 1: 15 Tabs left activeElement on BODY (soldier cycling only), and the HUD button «Abortar missão» (H.bAbort, l.1687) was never focused. Esc→Opções lists only the shared options (Som… Tamanho do texto) with the buttons «SAIR PARA O MENU» and «FECHAR». The combat dialog that has value 'abort' (l.1588–1592) is never shown. The key sheet (?) has no abort line, and the briefing says «escolha «Abortar missão»». Screenshot: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/persona/r3/acessivel/shots/112-inv.png (the combat Opções without Abortar)
findings.fix: In combat, add an «Abortar missão» button to the Esc options (it calls abortMission() with the existing confirmation). Give it a dedicated key, for example ⇧A or X with confirmation, and add a line «X · Abortar missão (só regressa quem estiver na nave)» to hud.keys.

findings.claim: When soldiers panic at the start of the X-COM turn, the turn summary does not mention it, and the squad list marks it only with a thin 3 px purple stripe (blue under deuteranopia), with no icon, text or aria. Tab silently skips those soldiers. I spent turn 10 not knowing why I could only control Jessica.
findings.evidence: Mission 1, turn 10. The «DURANTE O TURNO ALIENÍGENA» panel showed only «1 morto · João Almeida…». The log (N) had «Dieter Wagner / Omar Mostafa / Makoto Yamada / Chinedu Okonkwo entrou em pânico! … ficou paralisado de medo» under «TURNO 10 — FORÇAS X-COM». Their .bs-sq rows have class 'spent panic', computed border-left 3px solid rgb(180,140,255), aria-label with the name only and no title. Six Tabs gave selectedId 17 every time. Screenshots: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/persona/r3/acessivel/shots/087-t10.png, 089-state-now-crop.png (deuteranopia), 091-squad-normal-crop.png (normal vision), 090-log-panic.png
findings.fix: Include panics and berserks from the turn start in the summary (a section «No início do turno: 4 em pânico»). On the squad row, add an icon and a short text («PÂNICO», «DESCONTROLO») plus aria-label «Dieter Wagner — em pânico, sem UT neste turno». Show a toast when Tab skips soldiers in panic («3 soldados em pânico não podem agir»).

findings.claim: In the kit médico panel the keyboard model contradicts the screen. Tab is swallowed and focus stays on BODY even though the buttons have tabIndex 0. ↑/↓ change the patient although patients are laid out horizontally, and ←/→ change the body part although parts are listed vertically. The chosen part gets no visual highlight. None of these keys is shown in the panel.
findings.evidence: Mission 2: Q, then 1 «Usar…» opens «KIT MÉDICO · Dieter Wagner». Six Tabs left activeElement on BODY (keyMed, l.1377–1413, returns true for every key). ArrowRight twice: no .medk-pb gained 'on' or aria-pressed, and the screen looks the same. ArrowDown changed the patient to «Jessica Wilson» (the horizontal tab row). The only key hints are 1/2/3 on the actions. Screenshots: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/persona/r3/acessivel/shots/117-medkit-use.png, 118-medkit-arrows.png and 119-medkit-part.png
findings.fix: Map ←/→ to patients (the horizontal row) and ↑/↓ to body parts (the vertical list). Mark the chosen part with .on, aria-pressed and a visible outline, and select the first wounded part automatically. Let Tab/⇧Tab move natively between the panel's buttons (return false for Tab). Add a footer: «←/→ ferido · ↑/↓ parte do corpo · 1 Curar · 2 Estimulante · 3 Analgésico · Esc fecha».

findings.claim: The monthly report cannot be scrolled from the keyboard. ↓, PageDown and End do nothing, and Tab stays on «CONTINUAR». The hidden part holds the funding cuts (Nigéria −$43 000), the total and «Contas do mês». This is the same problem fixed in the debrief in round 2, now on a new screen.
findings.evidence: Report for «Janeiro de 1999»: .cp-mr-body.scr-scroll has scrollTop 0 of 221 with tabIndex −1. ArrowDown, PageDown and End all left it at 0, and four Tabs kept focus on BUTTON CONTINUAR. Rows below the fold: «Brasil… Nigéria $243 000 −$43 000 $200 000 … Portugal… Total $6 000 000 −$25 000 $5 975 000», plus the «CONTAS DO MÊS» section. Screenshot: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/persona/r3/acessivel/shots/120-month.png
findings.fix: In the monthly report's keys(), call OV.Screens.ui.scrollKeys(ev, body) (↑/↓/PageUp/PageDown/Home/End), as the debrief does, and give .cp-mr-body tabindex=0 with a visible :focus-visible. Optionally show a «▼ mais abaixo» marker while scrollTop < max.

findings.claim: Ainda presente (ronda 2), em parte: starting the campaign's first project with N, «Iniciar: Armas Laser» and Enter drops focus to BODY. On later starts, focus correctly returns to «NOVO PROJETO».
findings.evidence: 1 Jan 1999, Investigação tab (reached with → from the tablist), no project running. N opened the dialog with focus on «Iniciar: Armas Laser», and Enter gave activeElement BODY. On 3 Jan, N, «Iniciar: Kit Médico» and Enter gave focus on «NOVO PROJETO (1)». Screenshot: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/persona/r3/acessivel/shots/015-research-started.png
findings.fix: In the dialog's returnTo, resolve the [data-act=newResearch] button after renderContent(), because it is recreated when the list goes from 0 to 1 project. Use OV.Dom.refocus('[data-act=newResearch]', S.root) as the fallback when the original trigger is no longer in the DOM.

findings.claim: «Como Jogar» explains the path preview only by colour («verde… amarelo… vermelho»). The shapes now drawn (●, ○ and ✕) are not described anywhere. With «Sem reserva» active, hollow steps still appear because the preview falls back to the quick-shot reserve, while the label shows the normal cost, so a colour-blind player cannot tell what ○ means.
findings.evidence: scr.howto.tu.body: «O caminho aparece a verde… a amarelo… a vermelho». Mission 1, turn 2, reserve 'none': cursor at (14,11) gave pathStates ok×10, reserve×4, out×2 with the label «Custa 64 UT — só tem 56». At turn 1, destinations ending in 'reserve' read only «Custa 50 UT · ficam 5». battle_ui reserveMode() returns 'snap' when B.reserve is 'none'. Screenshot: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/persona/r3/acessivel/shots/059-path-out.png
findings.fix: Rewrite the help as: «● cheio: ainda sobra para um tiro rápido · ○ vazio: depois daqui já não dá para disparar · ✕: não chega» (and mention the colours as secondary). When the destination is ○ and there is no reserve, append «· sem UT para disparar» to the label.

findings.claim: In keyboard mode, the hint bar («Setas: cursor · Enter: andar · …») stays fixed over the map, just above the HUD, for the whole battle. It hides the soldiers and tiles at the bottom of the screen and cannot be dismissed.
findings.evidence: It appears on every turn of both missions (turns 1–10). Soldiers at the bottom are partly covered at y≈790 (screen coordinates ×1.28). Screenshots: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/persona/r3/acessivel/shots/064-t4-start.png, 070-ufo-view.png and 083-t7-start.png
findings.fix: Fade the bar after the first actions of the turn, or after ~6 s without changes, and bring it back with ?. Alternatively move it to the top next to the turn indicator, or let pointer-events and the camera keep a free margin so it does not cover units (offset the camera when the cursor gets close).

findings.claim: Inside the UFO, the aiming labels («Sem linha de tiro — obstáculo no caminho» and «Ctrl + clique ou Ctrl + Enter: tiro forçado») are drawn on top of the shooter and next to the target. The UFO walls in front also hide the selected soldier, so it is hard to tell who is shooting at what.
findings.evidence: Mission 1, turn 6: Anja at (11,17) aiming at the Sectoid at (10,19). The two labels cover the area between the two, and the soldier is visible only through the TU bar above the walls. Screenshot: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/persona/r3/acessivel/shots/081b-crop.png (crop of 081-blocked-aim.png)
findings.fix: Place the target label away from the shooter→target line (the opposite side, or a fixed position near the HUD). Cut away or make translucent the walls in front of the selected soldier and of the cursor tile.

findings.claim: In the base's build mode, the text only talks about the mouse («Posição válida: clique para construir.»), although arrows and Enter work. With the cursor in column A, the tooltip «Posição ocupada por outra instalação.» is cut off at the left edge of the screen.
findings.evidence: base.build.validHere is used with S.kcur active, and Enter opens «Construir Alojamentos por $400 000?». With the cursor at (2,2), the tooltip reads «…ocupada por outra instalação.» starting at x<0. Screenshots: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/persona/r3/acessivel/shots/020-build-mode.png and 126-build-invalid.png
findings.fix: Add a 'base.build.validHere.key' variant («Posição válida: Enter constrói · setas mudam a casa · Esc cancela») when the last input was the keyboard, and clamp the tooltip inside the viewport.

findings.claim: In «Escolher no globo» (destination for a craft), the crosshair is invisible until the first arrow press. After that press the instruction banner (setas + Enter… Esc cancela) is replaced by the coordinates, so the reminder of how to confirm or cancel disappears.
findings.evidence: Interceção → Intercetor-1 → G: no crosshair at the globe centre (104). After ArrowLeft the crosshair appears and the banner shows only «Ponto 31,1° N · 32,1° E 1620 mn · 46 min» (105). Screenshots: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/persona/r3/acessivel/shots/104-globe-pick.png and 105-globe-pick-arrow.png
findings.fix: Draw the crosshair as soon as target mode starts. Keep a second line under the coordinates: «Enter: escolher · Esc: cancelar».

findings.claim: Ainda presente (ronda 1/2), em parte: repeated buttons still have accessible names without context. In Investigação each project has «Atribuir mais 1 cientista / Retirar 5 cientistas / Atribuir todos os livres» with no project name. In the message log every «MOSTRAR» is «Centrar a câmara onde aconteceu». In the «Novo projeto» dialog the button is «Abrir o artigo da Ufopédia».
findings.evidence: Tab through Investigação with 2 projects: «+:Atribuir mais 1 cientista», «+5:Atribuir mais 5 cientistas», «TODOS:Atribuir todos os livres», repeated for Pistola Laser and Kit Médico. In N, three Tabs gave three «MOSTRAR:Centrar a câmara onde aconteceu». In Novo projeto: «UFOPÉDIA:Abrir o artigo da Ufopédia». Keys: base.sci.plus1, hud.report.show.tip, base.tip.article.
findings.fix: Interpolate the context: «Atribuir mais 1 cientista a Kit Médico», «Mostrar: Olivier Petit abateu Sectoide Navegador», «Abrir na Ufopédia: Kit Médico».

findings.claim: The Investigação subtitle uses the plural for a single project: «1 projetos disponíveis».
findings.evidence: 3 Jan 1999, Investigação tab: «Investigação / 1 projetos disponíveis / NOVO PROJETO (1)». The key 'base.research.sub': '{n} projetos disponíveis' has no singular form.
findings.fix: Use Tn with 'base.research.sub.one': '1 projeto disponível' / '.other': '{n} projetos disponíveis'.

findings.claim: In the briefing's Equipar at 1024×560, the soldier area (hands, belt, backpack) shows only 182 of 457 px. On opening, the hands are cut in half and the belt is invisible behind the help card, while the footer takes two rows with empty space.
findings.evidence: .inv-doll scrollHeight 457, clientHeight 182, and the belt label at y 429 is outside the visible area (149–331). The arrow keys scroll it when needed (scrollTop 267 on reaching the backpack), but the first view looks broken. Screenshots: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/persona/r3/acessivel/shots/046-brief-equip.png and 047-brief-equip-belt.png
findings.fix: Below ~620 px of height, collapse the help card to one line (or show it on ?), put the footer hint and the «CONCLUÍDO» button on the same row, and scale the doll down (smaller cells) so hands, belt and backpack fit.

delights: The keyboard cursor in combat now works from start to finish: I moved, aimed (E→2→Enter), threw a grenade with G (with the warning «Risco: 2 aliados no raio»), and won both missions without touching the mouse.
⌥+Enter opened the UFO door without walking in, and showed the real cost («Abrir a porta sem entrar · 6 UT»). When I was diagonal to the door it told me to stand next to it.
The path preview uses shapes: filled dots, hollow dots, an X and a cut-off line. The aliens have a triangle above them and an alien icon on the counter. With deuteranopia I can finally read it.
Base placement by keyboard: the arrows rotate the globe under the crosshair, Space picks the point and shows the country, and Enter founds the base.
Dialogs keep the focus inside and return it to the trigger. The base tabs change with ←/→, Soldados works with ↑/↓, and the base grid has a cursor for selecting and building.
After the alien turn, the panel tells me who died and from which shot, and «ATACANTE» can be reached with Tab and Enter.
The «Daltonismo» palette (blue/orange) in Opções › Acessibilidade, set by keyboard with a radiogroup and roving tabindex, plus the 115/130 % text sizes.
The interception plays entirely by keyboard (Q to switch off the missiles, 4 Agressivo) and has clear explanations.
The key list (?) now opens at the top, and the mission report scrolls with ↓/PageDown.

results.persona: Marta: iPad Pro 11" in Safari, touch only (emulated with Playwright: hasTouch/isMobile, 1194×834 landscape and 834×1194 portrait, DPR 2). Played a Recruta campaign (2 missions plus January through to the 1 Feb month report) and one night Quick Battle (terror site), about 55 min of real time.
results.summary: Ronda 3: confirmei corrigidos todos os achados anteriores da Marta que voltei a testar. O Return no nome da base já só fecha o teclado. A pinça e os dois dedos já não tiram zoom (5× no globo e 2× no combate ficam estáveis). A dica do «fantasma» na base já não apanha toques. Um toque numa linha do Armazém guarda o objeto escolhido. O Equipar em retrato funciona, tanto no briefing como na base. No HUD em retrato, a reserva de UT ficou numa linha própria e já não fica tapada pelo «Fim do turno». O toque longo nos botões do HUD mostra o nome. Durante o turno alienígena aparece «Toque para acelerar». O painel «Durante o turno alienígena» lê-se bem. A Ufopédia em retrato já não sobrepõe a figura ao texto. A base em retrato mostra a data. As linhas da tabela de Soldados têm 33 px. Lê-se «10 cientistas chegam». «Esperar pelo dia» dá agora uma missão de «Dia». Os recrutas embarcam e recebem armas sozinhos. A Batalha Rápida diz «1 alienígena». As Opções já falam em toque. Não houve erros de consola, zoom acidental da página nem scroll horizontal da página. Ao jogar, tudo se alcança com o dedo e os carregamentos são rápidos (combate em 3–5 s, turnos alienígenas de noite em 3–12 s). Os problemas novos são de polimento. Na Batalha Rápida noturna, o equipamento por defeito põe dois sinalizadores mesmo a quem não aguenta o peso: um soldado começa com 46/51 UT sem aviso no HUD. Em retrato, o quadro Financiamento esconde a coluna «Evolução», que não se consegue deslizar com o dedo. Na interceção e no aviso de sinalizadores ainda há textos só de teclado (M, Q/E, 2–5, L). Em retrato, os botões Copiar/Colar/Auto-equipar/Esvaziar têm 30 px, e os painéis de Equipar e Ufopédia deixam cerca de 300 px vazios enquanto o Armazém fica apertado. Os cartões de dificuldade mostram as teclas «1/2/3». Um toque duplo no mar ao escolher o local da base dá dois avisos iguais. O lançamento de sinalizador diz «Toque de novo para disparar». Nota de honestidade: para chegar ao relatório mensal, avancei o tempo a ignorar alguns OVNIs e um ataque terrorista (Cairo). Os disparos e movimentos foram feitos por um script de toques reais, que às vezes falhava por culpa do script (centrar na câmara) e não do jogo.

findings.claim: In a night Quick Battle, the default kit adds two Sinalizadores (belt + pack) to every non-heavy soldier without checking Força. A soldier with low Força starts overweight and loses TU, and the battle HUD shows 46/46, hiding the penalty.
findings.evidence: Quick Battle: Local de Terror, Noite, Recruta, 8 soldiers (seed 91277). Equipar shows «Anita Reddy Peso 23/21 — Excesso de peso: começa a missão com menos UT» (shots/115_qb_equip.png). In combat, B.units gives «Anita Reddy tu46/51» and the HUD shows UT 46/46 (shots/116_qb_start.png). Code: loadoutFor() lines 795–805 always does lo.pack.push('electro_flare') after the belt flare. Only medkits use medPicks/Força slack. Screenshots in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-HelloWorld/b8cfbac1-629a-5f58-8dfb-0f752cc84b7c/scratchpad/persona/r3/ipad/shots/.
findings.fix: In buildQuickMission (or loadoutFor with the soldier), add the 2nd flare only if loWeight(lo)+flare.weight ≤ Força. Otherwise put it in mission.craftItems, as is already done with a medkit that does not fit. Optional: in the HUD show «UT 46/51» or a ⚖ icon when the soldier started overweight.

findings.claim: In portrait (834×1194), the country table in Financiamento overflows sideways and the «Evolução» column (sparkline) is cut off at «EV». The box (.geo-fund-l.scroll) has touch-action: pan-y, so a horizontal finger swipe does not scroll it. On iPad, that column can never be seen.
findings.evidence: Geoscape → Financiamento in portrait: the EVOLUÇÃO header sits at x=302, w=76 in a 254 px box (scrollWidth 309 > clientWidth 254, overflow-x:auto, touchAction 'pan-y'). A 150 px horizontal drag leaves scrollLeft=0; a vertical drag scrolls (scrollTop=135). Shot: shots/093_funding_port.png (header «EV» cut off). In landscape (shots/094_funding_land.png) it fits (443/443).
findings.fix: Under @media (max-width:900px), put the Financiamento dialog in one column (country table at 100% width, chart below) so the table does not overflow. Or give .geo-fund-l touch-action: pan-x pan-y, overriding the generic .scroll{touch-action:pan-y} rule in base.css:58.

findings.claim: Partly still present (round 2): in the Geoscape there are still keyboard-only texts on the iPad. The interception hint says «Normal (3) … 2 Cauteloso … 4 Agressivo … 5 Desengatar … Q/E ligam e desligam cada arma». The banner over the open combat says «M abre a janela de combate.». The night-arrival popup says «em combate lançam-se com L para iluminar».
findings.evidence: Intercepting OVNI-3 by touch: shots/075_intercept_event.png (hint with 2–5 and Q/E; top banner «Tempo parado: interceção em curso · M abre a janela de combate.»). After it was shot down: shots/076_df_min.png («…lançam-se com L para iluminar»). Keys without a .touch variant: 'df.hint.modes' (pt-PT.dogfight.js:9), 'geo.dfBanner.text' (pt-PT.geoui.js:373), 'geo.ev.team.eta.night.flares.one/other' (pt-PT.geoui.js:241-242).
findings.fix: Add '.touch' variants and pick them with isTouch()/lastPointerType, as already done for other keys. 'df.hint.modes.touch': «Começa em Normal: a nave aproxima-se até ao alcance da arma mais curta. Cauteloso dispara de mais longe, Agressivo encosta, Desengatar regressa. Os interruptores ligam e desligam cada arma.» 'geo.dfBanner.text.touch': «Toque na ficha da interceção para a abrir.» '…flares.*.touch': «…em combate lançam-se com o botão do sinalizador para iluminar.»

findings.claim: In portrait, the Equipar buttons (Copiar, Colar, Auto-equipar, Esvaziar) are 30 px tall, under the 32 px minimum. At the same time, the Equipar and Ufopédia panels leave about 300 px empty at the bottom. The Armazém list is capped at 260 px and the Ufopédia text box is short, so you scroll a lot inside small boxes.
findings.evidence: small() in portrait, in both the briefing Equipar and the base Equipar: «Copiar (C) 107x30, Colar (V) 77x30, Auto-equipar (A) 107x30, Esvaziar (X) 77x30». Rule battle.css:677 «@container eq (max-width:1060px) … .eq-btns .btn { min-height: 30px }». Empty space: shots/039_cp_equip_port.png (panel ends at about 1050 of 1194 CSS px, Armazém shows 1.5 rows), shots/136_base_equip_port.png (about 240 px empty below the 260 px Armazém, from .eq-stores-list{max-height:260px}). findings.fix: Inside @media (hover:none), keep .eq-btns .btn at min-height:36px in the ≤1060px container. findings.claim: In «Escolha a dificuldade», the three cards show key badges «1», «2», «3» on the iPad, where there are no number keys. The hover:none rule only hides .btn .key/.modal .key, not .cp-diff-n.
findings.evidence: New Campaign, step 1, landscape touch: the 1/2/3 badges in the top-right corner of the Recruta, Veterano and Super-humano cards (shots/002_newcamp.png). Element: el('span', {class:'cp-diff-n', text: String(d+1)}) at campaign_ui.js:594. base.css:139-143 does not cover it.
findings.fix: In campaign.css, inside the existing @media (hover:none) block (line 255), add «.cp-diff-n { display:none; }». Or give the span class 'key' so the generic rule in base.css hides it.

findings.claim: When choosing the first base's site, a double tap on the sea (the gesture the hint suggests for «Toque duplo: centrar») centres the globe but also shows the warning «A base tem de ficar em terra firme.» twice, stacked. The centre gesture also differs from the Geoscape, which teaches «toque longo centra».
findings.evidence: New Campaign → Recruta → Escolher local; double tap at (300,250) over the Atlantic. The globe centres, and two identical toasts appear at the top (shots/133_ng_after_dbl.png, compare shots/132_ng_before_dbl.png). Hint on this screen: «Arrastar: rodar · Pinça: aproximar · Toque: escolher · Toque duplo: centrar». Hint in the Geoscape: «…toque para selecionar · toque longo centra» (shots/006_geo_intro.png).
findings.fix: In the site-picking scene, delay the error from the 1st tap by about 250 ms and cancel it if a 2nd tap arrives (double tap = centre only), or do not repeat a toast already on screen (dedupe in OV.Dom.toast). Accept long press = centre here too, and use the same text as the Geoscape («toque longo centra») so one gesture is taught.

findings.claim: When throwing a Sinalizador (or a grenade) by touch, the confirmation label says «Toque de novo para disparar · Lançar · 18 UT». The confirm-shot key is reused for a throw, and «disparar» sounds odd for a throw.
findings.evidence: QB night: flare button → tap a tile → label {"label":"Toque de novo para disparar · Lançar · 18 UT"} (state().throwInfo; shots/118_flare_target.png). Code: battle_ui.js:773 «label = T('hud.confirmFire') + ' · ' + label» in throw mode; 'hud.confirmFire' = 'Toque de novo para disparar' (pt-PT.hud.js:121).
findings.fix: Add 'hud.confirmThrow': 'Toque de novo para lançar' (and the mouse variant «Clique de novo para lançar»), and use it in the throw branch (mode 'throw') instead of hud.confirmFire.

delights: Picking the base site by touch, with the dotted radar circle and the coverage chips (Reino Unido, França, Espanha, Portugal…), then the virtual keyboard to name it «Base Sintra»; Return now only closes the keyboard.
The Equipar screen in portrait finally works: tap the object and then the destination, «Na arma» on the clip, 20/20 on the rifle, and tapping an Armazém row puts the grenade away.
Two-finger zoom and panning that stay put: 5× on the globe and 2× in combat without slipping.
Tap the weapon, choose «Tiro apontado», tap the Sectoid («Acerto ≈ 49 % · Toque de novo para disparar») and tap again: one shot, one kill, Rekha promoted to Sargento.
The «Durante o turno alienígena» panel with a button to centre on the attacker, and the «Toque para acelerar» banner during the night turns.
Long press on the HUD icons shows «Mapa tático»: you finally find out what each button does.
Mission reports in portrait that read well: «Em memória» with the fallen soldiers, items delivered to the Base Sintra stores, and promotions.
The interceptor shooting down the UFO, then «Esperar pelo dia» giving a daytime mission after all.
